obligations.expected_behavior: When Replay, seed, matrix, review, or Quick Dev artifacts expose authorization metadata, the machine-verifiable authorization set is empty.
forbidden_result: Any listed artifact exposes a non-empty machine-verifiable authorization set.
obligations.observable_result: Machine-verifiable inspection of each specified artifact reports an empty authorization set.
obligations.state_after: The specified artifacts expose empty machine-verifiable authorization sets.
obligations.state_before: The authorization-set exposure of the specified artifacts is not established by this requirement.
obligations.subject: Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts
obligations.trigger: Artifact authorization metadata is exposed or machine-verified.

obligations.expected_behavior: Publishing an acceptance-passed result is authorized only for the current Acceptance lifecycle owner; attempts by any other actor are rejected.
forbidden_result: An actor other than the current Acceptance lifecycle owner is treated as authorized to publish acceptance-passed.
obligations.observable_result: The current Acceptance lifecycle owner can publish acceptance-passed, while every non-owner publication attempt is denied.
obligations.state_after: Only the current Acceptance lifecycle owner can publish acceptance-passed.
obligations.state_before: An actor attempts to publish acceptance-passed, without the requirement establishing that the actor is the current Acceptance lifecycle owner.
obligations.subject: Acceptance-passed publication authorization
obligations.trigger: An actor attempts to publish acceptance-passed.
